site.name: ccam
site.title: ccam: Claude Code Account Manager da mai sauya asusu
site.description: ccam (Claude Code Account Manager) kayan aiki ne kyauta kuma open-source don amfani da asusun Claude Code da dama a kwamfuta ɗaya da sauya su da umarni ɗaya.

facts.what: ccam kayan aikin command-line ne kyauta kuma open-source wanda ke ba ka damar amfani da asusun Claude Code da dama a kwamfuta ɗaya, ka kuma sauya tsakaninsu da umarni ɗaya.
facts.how: Kowane asusu yana riƙe bayanan shigarsa a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR daban, yayin da za a iya raba sabobin MCP, saituna, CLAUDE.md, extensions da tarihin tattaunawa tsakanin asusai, don haka za ka iya ci gaba da tattaunawa a wani asusu idan ɗaya ya kai iyakar amfaninsa.
facts.install: Girka shi a Linux, macOS ko Windows da umarni ɗaya, sannan ka gudanar da ccam add ga kowane asusu.
facts.official: ccam aiki ne da ba na hukuma ba, ba shi da alaƙa da Anthropic, kuma Anthropic ba ta amince da shi ba.

landing.headline: Asusun Claude Code da dama. Terminal ɗaya.
landing.lede: Ka ƙara kowane asusu sau ɗaya. Ka sauya da ccam work ko gajeren umarni kamar ccwork. Idan wani asusu ya kai iyakarsa, ka ci gaba a na gaba da wannan tattaunawar.
landing.thenAdd: Sannan ka ƙara asusunka na farko da {command}.
landing.boardLabel: Misalin zama: idan wani asusu ya kai iyakarsa, ccam yana ci gaba da tattaunawar a wani asusu

demo.title: Idan wani asusu ya kai iyakarsa

steps.body: Ka fara Claude Code da ɗaya daga cikin asusanka ta gajeren umarninsa.
Wannan asusun ya kai iyakarsa ta awa 5, kuma Claude Code ya tsaya.
Ka ga amfanin awa 5 da na mako na kowane asusu a lokaci ɗaya.
Ka buɗe asusun da ya fi sauran sarari, ka ci gaba da wannan tattaunawar.

flow.body: Yana ƙirƙirar folda ta saituna daban don asusun, yana buɗe shigar Claude a burauzarka kuma, idan kana so, yana ba asusun gajeren umarni da kai da kanka ka sa masa suna, kamar ccwork.
Yana fara Claude Code a matsayin wannan asusun. Duk abin da ke bayan sunan yana zuwa Claude Code ba tare da canji ba, kuma ccam yana ƙara kusan millisecond 4 kafin ya fara.
Yana zaɓar abin da asusun zai raba da sauran asusunka. Ana raba sabobin MCP, saituna, CLAUDE.md da extensions tun daga farko; ba a taɓa raba bayanan shiga ba.
Yana nuna amfanin awa 5 da na mako na kowane asusu a lokaci ɗaya, don ka san wanne ne yake da sauran sarari.
Yana buɗe wannan tattaunawar a asusu na gaba idan na yanzu ya kai iyakarsa.
Yana duba mahaɗai, izini da bayanan shiga, kuma yana gyara abin da zai iya gyarawa lafiya. Kowane canji ga fayilolinka yana ajiye kwafin ajiya.

docs.machine: Na'ura ce ta fassara wannan shafin daga Turanci. Ana maraba da gyare-gyare.

hubs.docs: Girka ccam, ƙara asusun Claude Code ɗinka, zaɓi abin da za su raba kuma ka nemo kowane umarni, tare da amsoshin tambayoyin da aka saba yi.
hubs.guides: Jagorori mataki-mataki don gudanar da asusun Claude Code da dama a kwamfuta ɗaya: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, iyakokin amfani da Remote Control.
hubs.features: Kowane fasalin ccam dalla-dalla, tare da dukan zaɓuɓɓukansa: asusai, gajerun umarni, rabawa, sabobin MCP, amfani, sauyawa, gyare-gyare da sabuntawa.
hubs.compare: Yadda ccam ya kwatantu da alias na shell da sauran masu sauya asusun Claude Code, fasali bayan fasali, don ka zaɓi kayan aikin da ya dace.
hubs.blog: Labarai daga aikin ccam: dalilin samuwarsa, yadda yake aiki da abin da ke canzawa ga masu amfani da asusun Claude Code da dama.

commands.ccam: Buɗe dashboard: asusai, rukunoni, foldoji, extensions da lafiya
commands.name: Fara Claude Code a matsayin wannan asusun; ana miƙa arguments ba tare da canji ba
commands.fallback: Don gudun -p: a iyakar amfani, sake gudanar da umarnin iri ɗaya a matsayin asusun da ya fi sarari
commands.add: Ƙara asusu: folda ta saituna, shiga da gajeren umarni na zaɓi
commands.next: Buɗe asusu na gaba; --continue yana kai tattaunawar gaba, --auto yana zaɓar wanda ya fi sarari
commands.usage: Nuna amfanin awa 5 da na mako na kowane asusu
commands.share: Nuna abin da asusu ke rabawa, da kuma ta wane rukuni
commands.group: Ƙirƙira da canza rukunoni: abin da wasu asusai ke rabawa, ana matsar da shi tare da shiri
commands.mcp: Sarrafa sabobin MCP da aka raba
commands.migrate: Kwafi saitin Claude Code da ke akwai (~/.claude) zuwa rukunin da aka raba
commands.login: Sake shiga da asusu; --expired yana shiga kowane asusu da ke buƙatar hakan
commands.rename: Sauya sunan asusu; sunan gajeren umarninsa ba ya canzawa
commands.remove: Cire asusu; foldarsa tana komawa foldar shara
commands.import: Yi rajistar foldar ~/.claude da ke akwai a inda take
commands.doctor: Duba mahaɗai, izini, bayanan shiga da sigogi, sannan ka gyara
commands.statusline: Nuna asusun da amfaninsa a layin matsayi na Claude Code
commands.shims: Sake ƙirƙirar mahaɗan gajerun umarnin dukkan asusai
commands.shortcut: Nuna, ƙirƙira, sauya suna ko cire gajeren umarnin asusu, kamar ccwork
commands.folder: Yi amfani da asusu a folda da ƙarƙashinta idan ba a ambaci asusu ba
commands.pick: Buga asusun da ya fi sarari, don rubutun umarni da workers masu aiki a lokaci guda
commands.ext: Nuna skills, commands, plugins, sabobin MCP da hooks da kowane asusu ke lodawa
commands.agents: Lissafa background agents da zaman da ke buɗe na kowane asusu
commands.attach: Buɗe zaman bayan fage a matsayin asusun da ya fara shi
commands.hook: Hooks na plugin ɗin ccam a Claude Code ne ke gudanar da shi (iyakokin amfani, /ccam:switch)
commands.update: Sabunta ccam zuwa sakin baya-bayan nan bayan duba checksum nasa
commands.completion: Buga completion na bash, zsh ko PowerShell

footer.unofficial: ccam kayan aikin open-source ne da ba na hukuma ba. Ba shi da alaƙa da Anthropic, kuma Anthropic ba ta amince da shi ba. Claude da Claude Code alamomin kasuwanci ne na Anthropic.
